node.title: Ahorro por reutilización cualificada
node.summary: Reuse can save effort when scope, permissions and validity are checked.

relations: Qualified reuse can reduce the cost of clarity only after source production, discovery, integration, per-use verification and renewal costs are counted.
El criterio algebraico identifica una clase posible; no demuestra ahorro neto ni descubrimiento barato en campo.
